parameters.content:
## Receive and acknowledge

Only realtime.call.incoming is handled; everything else is acknowledged and ignored. The 200 goes out before any work.

## Session start

The UUI comes out of the INVITE headers (User-to-User, hex). AR-01 starts the n8n session as the gateway would; a failed start rejects the call with 486.

## Accept

The accept body carries the greeting, the session id, the proof prompt and the MCP tool server on n8n. The sideband sidecar (scripts/ar-sideband.mjs) is told the call id and sends the greeting response.create; a sidecar that is down does not block the store. The call id is stored on the session for the REFER.

## AR-51 OpenAI call incoming

Accept within two seconds: the 200 goes first, then AR-01 and the accept. The prompt is a short proof prompt, not the AR-02 turn prompt. Webhook signature (Standard Webhooks HMAC) is not verified on the lab: a forged call id fails at the accept.

meta.description: POST /webhook/ar/openai/call-incoming, the OpenAI webhook for realtime.call.incoming. Reads the UUI from the SIP headers, starts the n8n session (AR-01), accepts the call with the greeting, the session id and the n8n MCP tool server, and stores the call id on the session for the REFER. Responds 200 before the accept; signature verification is a PoC exception.

exceptions.reason: OpenAI Realtime SIP: POST /v1/realtime/calls/{id}/accept has no operation in the OpenAI node; the request carries the OpenAI credential.
OpenAI Realtime SIP: POST /v1/realtime/calls/{id}/reject has no operation in the OpenAI node; the request carries the OpenAI credential.
